title: Eigenvalue-by-Eigenvalue Comparison of a Sierra--Rodríguez-Laguna-Type Spectrum with the Riemann Zeros
summary: We study the self-adjoint extension of the Sierra--Rodríguez-Laguna (SR) $H=xp$-type Hamiltonian $\widehat H_{SR}$. Its discrete spectrum is fixed by the equation $\mathrm{Re}\!\left[e^{-iθ/2}K_{1/2+iE/2}(2π)\right]=0$. We solve this equation numerically for $θ=1.417π$ and obtain the first 606 eigenvalues $E_n$. We compare them, one by one, with the ordinates $γ_n$ of the first 606 nontrivial zeros of the Riemann zeta function.
